title: Cloud-computer errand agents
tagline: Tell one app a goal; it works in a cloud browser and pings your iPhone for logins and the Pay button.
moment: It is Sunday night and you have five errands: return a jacket, book a haircut, renew a parking permit. You dictate them into one app, lock the phone, and a Live Activity ticks through each one while the agent works in its own cloud computer. It stops twice: once for a password, once before paying.
what_it_does: Breaks a spoken or typed goal into steps and runs them in a cloud virtual computer or browser, not on the phone
Signs into the sites and accounts you connect, fills forms, sends email and compares options
Pauses and hands control back at logins, CAPTCHAs, licence checks and the Pay button
Pays only after you approve, often with a one-time virtual card (Muse uses Stripe Link)
Reports back with a step-by-step log and the result, by push or in the app
why_now: Meta's Muse (Sept 8, 2026) took #1 on the US free iPhone chart with 2.5M+ downloads; ChatGPT added a voice-driven Work tab on iPhone on Sept 23, 2026; Gemini Spark launched at I/O in May 2026. Cloud sandboxes and cheaper frontier models made long multi-step runs affordable enough to put in a consumer app.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Crowded, and owned by the largest labs: Meta (Muse, plus Manus, bought for a reported $2B+), OpenAI (ChatGPT agent and Work tab), Google (Gemini Spark, Pro/Ultra only), Perplexity (Computer, Comet), xAI (Grok Bot) and Genspark. All run off-device because iOS will not let an app operate other apps. Going fast on downloads, uneven on reliability: CNN's Muse test saw a purchase stall at a store that required a professional licence, and Spark still loads the checkout page but will not press Pay. Most launches are US-only or on paid tiers.
ios_hooks: ActivityKit (Live Activities for run progress, push-to-start)
App Intents (start a task from Siri or the Action button)
nearest_existing: Meta Muse (https://9to5mac.com/2026/09/17/meta-ai-launches-muse-personal-agent-including-a-new-mobile-app-for-iphone/): email, travel, forms, one-time-card checkout and business calls; US 18+
ChatGPT agent and Work tab (https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/23/chatgpt-mobile-app-gets-voice-based-agentic-features/): cloud-browser tasks started by voice on iPhone
Gemini Spark (https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/17094507?hl=en&co=GENIE.Platform%3DiOS): 24/7 agent across Gmail, Docs and signed-in sites; hands payments back to you
Manus (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/manus-ai-agent-automation/id6740909540): virtual-computer agent that shows every step; now Meta-owned
Genspark Super Agent (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/genspark-super-ai-agent/id6739554054): 80+ tools including Call for Me
unsaid_assumption: That people will hand one company the logins to many services, as long as money and passwords still need their tap.
surprise: The iPhone lost the agent but kept the approval: every heavy agent runs in someone else's cloud, and the phone became the remote control and the place you press Pay.

title: Phone-call errand agents
tagline: An agent phones businesses from a cloud number to get quotes, hold slots and wait on hold, then reports back.
moment: Your car needs brakes and you hate calling around. You give the agent the car, your zip code and a budget. Twenty minutes later you have three shop quotes and a Thursday slot on hold, and you never dialed.
what_it_does: Turns your request into a call plan: who to call, what to ask, what you would accept
Dials from cloud telephony (Genspark runs on Twilio), works phone trees and waits on hold
Talks to the person who answers and collects prices, availability and reference numbers
Asks you before booking anything, sharing account details or going outside your limits
Sends a transcript and a structured summary by push, text or email
why_now: Google's 'Let Google Call' grew out of the Search Labs 'Ask for Me' test and now phones salons, auto shops and groomers; Genspark's Call for Me moved onto Twilio Programmable Voice in Feb 2026; Muse switched on outbound business calls around Sept 17, 2026. Real-time voice models got good enough to survive hold queues and phone trees.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Google (Search AI Mode), Genspark, Meta Muse, Pine AI and small apps such as Assindo are building it. Every one places calls from the cloud, because iOS gives third parties no access to cellular calls, and Apple's Hold Assist and Call Screening are locked inside the Phone app. It is going well for information calls (price, hours, availability) and harder when the call needs identity checks, account PINs or a live handoff to you.
ios_hooks: App Intents (start a call task from Siri)
CallKit / LiveCommunicationKit (only for a VoIP handoff inside the app)
nearest_existing: Google 'Let Google Call' (https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/shopping/how-to-agentic-calling-let-google-call/): calls local businesses about prices and availability
Genspark Call for Me (https://www.genspark.ai/helpcenter/call-for-me): multilingual outbound calls for bookings and customer service
Meta Muse calls (https://9to5mac.com/2026/09/17/meta-ai-launches-muse-personal-agent-including-a-new-mobile-app-for-iphone/): outbound calls to US businesses since mid-Sept 2026
Assindo (https://assindo.com/news/never-wait-on-hold-ai-phone-calls): consumer call agent that waits on hold and works IVR menus on iOS, Android and web
unsaid_assumption: That businesses keep answering calls from AI agents instead of blocking them or putting their own AI receptionist on the line.
surprise: The busiest agent channel on the iPhone is the oldest one, a phone call, and it works because the call never touches the iPhone.

title: Inbox triage-and-draft agents
tagline: An agent sorts your mail, writes replies in your voice and leaves them in Drafts for you to send.
moment: You open your mail app at 7am and 14 replies are already drafted in your tone. You fix one sentence, send nine, and see that the agent filed the newsletters and flagged the one invoice that needs you.
what_it_does: Reads new mail through the Gmail or Microsoft Graph API on a server
Labels threads (to reply, FYI, receipts, marketing) and surfaces to-dos
Writes reply drafts in your style and saves them to your real Drafts folder
Proposes meeting times or routes work to partner agents (Superhuman Go calls Box, Gamma and others)
Sends nothing without your tap unless you set a narrow rule
why_now: Gmail's AI Inbox view went to trusted testers in Jan 2026; Superhuman Go launched partner agents with an iOS app; Gemini Spark acts across Gmail. Models now match a person's writing style well enough that drafts are usable as-is.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Busy but web-first: Fyxer, Shortwave, Superhuman Go and Google's own Gmail features. Fyxer has no iPhone app and still works on iPhone, because its drafts appear in whatever mail app you use. iOS has no Mail.app API (MailKit is macOS-only), so an iPhone inbox agent must run server-side on Gmail or Outlook APIs, or be the mail client itself.
ios_hooks: App Intents mail schema (so Siri AI can act on drafts)
nearest_existing: Superhuman Go (https://www.grammarly.com/blog/company/superhuman-go-new-partner-agents/): directs first-party and partner agents; has an iOS app
Gmail AI Inbox (https://fortune.com/2026/01/08/google-ai-inbox-gmail-gemini-3-integration-email-new-view-features/): summaries, topics and to-dos; trusted testers first
Fyxer (https://tldv.io/blog/fyxer-ai-review/): sorts and drafts inside Gmail and Outlook; no dedicated iPhone app
Shortwave (https://www.usecarly.com/blog/fyxer-vs-shortwave/): AI-native Gmail client with a multi-step assistant
unsaid_assumption: That Google and Microsoft keep granting broad read-and-draft API scopes to third-party agents.
surprise: The inbox agents that work barely need an iPhone app: they write into your Drafts folder on the server, so the stock mail app becomes their interface.

title: Scheduling negotiator agents
tagline: CC or text an assistant; it trades times with the other side, sends the invite and chases replies.
moment: A client emails asking to meet next week. You reply-all with 'Howie, find 30 minutes' and go back to your run. By lunch the invite is on both calendars with a video link and a note about the time zone.
what_it_does: Reads the thread it is copied on, plus your calendar availability
Proposes times to the other party by email or text and handles the back-and-forth
Sends the invite and adds links or rooms
Asks you only when your rules clash (a focus block, an evening request from a VIP)
Chases non-replies and reschedules when something moves
why_now: Howie reports 1,000+ paying customers booking 5,000+ meetings a week, including over iMessage; Claude on iOS now creates and edits Calendar events; Siri AI can chain calendar intents in iOS 27.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Split field. Email and iMessage assistants (Howie) do real negotiation. AI calendars are weak on the phone: Motion's iPhone app mostly views and edits while scheduling runs on desktop, Reclaim has no native iOS app, and Clockwise reportedly shut down in March 2026 after Salesforce bought it. No true mobile-first autonomous calendar agent exists yet.
nearest_existing: Howie (https://howie.com/): scheduling assistant with its own email address and phone number; works over iMessage
Motion (https://efficient.app/compare/motion-vs-reclaim): auto-scheduling calendar whose planning engine is desktop-first
Reclaim.ai (https://get-alfred.ai/blog/best-ai-calendar-assistants): habit and focus-time blocking; owned by Dropbox
Claude iOS Calendar integration (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11869619-use-claude-with-ios-apps): creates and edits Calendar events on the phone
Clockwise, reportedly shut down March 2026 (https://get-alfred.ai/compare/motion-vs-clockwise)
unsaid_assumption: That the other side accepts negotiating with an assistant, and will more and more often be one.
surprise: The best scheduling agent on iPhone has no calendar screen at all; it lives in email and iMessage, while the famous AI calendars still need a laptop.

title: Trip booking and rebooking agents
tagline: Agents that search and book trips and, when a flight dies, propose a rebooking before you reach the desk.
moment: Your 6pm connection is cancelled while you are still in the air. When you land, a notification already lists two rebooking options and a hotel hold near the airport. You tap the second one and walk past the rebooking line.
what_it_does: Plans and books flights and hotels through supplier APIs (Muse uses Duffel) or partner booking flows
Watches bookings for delays, cancellations and schedule changes
Ranks alternatives against your rules: arrival time, airline, budget, status
Asks you to confirm any change that costs money or moves a date
Updates your calendar, Wallet passes and a Live Activity with the new plan
why_now: Expedia bought Layla in July 2026 and talks about 'self-healing' trips; Google AI Mode added hotel booking in Aug 2026; Muse books flights through Duffel; Hopper's HTS Assist cancels, refunds and rebooks without a human. Industry reports frame 2026 as the year airline disruption agents moved from pilots to production.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Booking is crowded: Expedia with Layla, Google AI Mode, Meta Muse, Airbnb and Mindtrip. Disruption handling is being built mostly on the airline and booking-platform side (Hopper HTS, airline re-accommodation agents), so a consumer agent often just relays the carrier's offer. A neutral agent that fights for the traveller is thinner, partly because changing a ticket needs airline or agency access, and App Review wants air-travel apps submitted by the entity that provides the service.
ios_hooks: App Intents travel entities (Tripsy is a named Siri AI partner)
nearest_existing: Expedia + Layla (https://ir.expediagroup.com/news-and-events/news/news-details/2026/Expedia-Group-acquires-Layla-accelerating-its-AI-powered-trip-planning-and-booking-strategy/default.aspx): conversational planner and booker; 'self-healing' trips planned
Google AI Mode hotel booking (https://skift.com/2026/08/27/googles-agentic-hotel-booking-tool-comes-to-ai-mode/)
Meta Muse travel (https://www.phocuswire.com/news/technology/meta-launches-ai-agent-travel-booking): books flights through the Duffel API
Hopper HTS Assist (https://venturebeat.com/infrastructure/hoppers-ai-agent-can-book-flights-and-cancel-trips-without-human-help): cancels, refunds and rebooks through airline systems
unsaid_assumption: That airlines will let a third-party agent change a ticket rather than routing every change through their own app.
surprise: Disruption, the travel job people would most pay an agent for, is being automated first for the airline, so the traveller's agent risks becoming a messenger for the carrier's offer.

title: Price-watch auto-buy agents
tagline: Set a target price once; the agent watches the item and buys when it drops, within a budget you set.
moment: You want a specific stroller, but not at $480. You tell the shopping agent 'buy it at 30% off, black, ship to home.' Three weeks later a notification says it bought it for $329 and shows the return window.
what_it_does: Tracks one item's price at a retailer or across many merchants
Checks variant, seller and delivery date against your rules
Buys with saved payment when the price crosses your line (Amazon Auto Buy) or asks first (Google agentic checkout)
Completes checkout on other stores with your saved address (Amazon Buy for Me)
Tracks the order and the return window after purchase
why_now: Amazon replaced Rufus with Alexa for Shopping on May 13, 2026, with Auto Buy and Buy for Me; Google's agentic checkout (Nov 2025) and Universal Cart (I/O 2026) run on Google Pay and the Universal Commerce Protocol; Visa and Mastercard shipped agent payment tokens.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Owned by the platforms that already hold your payment method: Amazon, Google, and Meta Muse (one-time Stripe Link cards). Buying inside a chatbot is retreating: OpenAI dropped Instant Checkout in March 2026 after Walmart measured it converting about 3x worse than a click-through to its own site. Apple has no agent-payment API, so an iOS app cannot let an agent use Apple Pay without a Face ID tap per purchase.
ios_hooks: Visual Intelligence (snap a product to start tracking)
nearest_existing: Amazon Alexa for Shopping, Auto Buy and Buy for Me (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/13/amazon-ditches-rufus-ai-chatbot-in-favor-of-alexa-shopping-agent.html)

Google agentic checkout and Universal Cart (https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/shopping/agentic-checkout-holiday-ai-shopping/): buys via Google Pay at your target price, after confirming
ChatGPT Instant Checkout, discontinued March 2026 (https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/03/06/openai-shifts-checkout-plans-agentic-commerce-strategy/)
Meta Muse checkout (https://about.fb.com/news/2026/09/introducing-muse-personal-ai-agent/): pays with one-time Stripe Link cards
unsaid_assumption: That the agent works for you and not for the store whose search results it ranks.
surprise: The standing rule beat the chat: 'buy at this price' shipped widely, while buying inside a chatbot converted about 3x worse and was pulled.

title: Money autopilot agents
tagline: Link your accounts; the agent plans goals and moves money within your limits, then texts you what it did.
moment: Payday lands on a Friday. Before you check your balance, the agent has paid the card in full, moved $180 to your trip fund and texted: 'Held back $60 because your car insurance renews Tuesday. Undo?'
what_it_does: Pulls transactions through aggregators such as Plaid, or FinanceKit for Apple Card and Apple Cash
Builds a plan around goals, bills and subscriptions
Moves money between your own accounts inside caps and pre-approved rules
Texts or pushes a summary with undo, and asks before anything outside the rules
Flags savings such as subscriptions to cancel or cheaper insurance (on Cleo's 2026 roadmap)
why_now: Cleo launched Autopilot in Feb 2026; ChatGPT added Plaid-linked finances across 12,000+ institutions for US Plus and Pro users; Rocket Money reportedly launched Rowan, built with Anthropic, which texts savings opportunities. iOS 26 gave FinanceKit a background delivery extension.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Cleo, OpenAI and Rocket Money are building it, mostly US-only. Trust is the ceiling: Menlo's 2026 survey found only 20% of AI users have given an agent a financial account, against 36% for email. Most 'autopilot' today moves money between the user's own accounts; paying third parties is rare. Rowan's details come from one trade report and are unconfirmed.
ios_hooks: FinanceKit (Apple Card/Cash data, background delivery extension)
nearest_existing: Cleo Autopilot (https://web.meetcleo.com/blog/introducing-autopilot): plans goals and acts within user-set limits
ChatGPT finances (https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/15/openai-launches-chatgpt-for-personal-finance-will-let-you-connect-bank-accounts/): Plaid-linked dashboard and Q&A
Rocket Money Rowan (https://www.pymnts.com/news/artificial-intelligence/2026/this-ai-agent-ends-subscriptions-without-a-phone-call/): texts savings opportunities; unconfirmed
unsaid_assumption: That regulators keep treating an agent moving your money between your own accounts as a feature, not as financial advice.
surprise: People hand agents their email almost twice as often as their bank (36% vs 20%), so the money agents that ship stay inside your own accounts and sell the undo button as hard as the automation.

title: Bill-fighting and cancel agents
tagline: An agent calls, emails and chats with companies to lower bills, cancel subscriptions and chase refunds.
moment: Your internet bill jumped $25 when the promo ended. You forward the bill and tap 'negotiate.' Two days later the agent reports it waited 40 minutes on hold, got a $20-a-month credit, and needs your OK before accepting a 12-month term.
what_it_does: Reads a forwarded bill or linked account to find the target
Calls the provider through cloud telephony, waits on hold and works retention menus
Uses email and web chat for cancellations and refund requests
Stops to ask before agreeing to a contract, sharing an account PIN or accepting an offer
Tracks the savings and follows up until the credit shows on the next bill
why_now: Pine pairs a calling agent with an email and web agent; Muse negotiated bills and a car sale at launch; Rocket Money's Rowan reportedly cancels subscriptions without a phone call; Cleo lists bill negotiation among its 2026 Autopilot actions. Hold-and-menu voice agents became dependable in 2026.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Pine AI, Rocket Money, Meta Muse and Cleo (planned). Pine claims $300+ average yearly savings and a 93% negotiation success rate, but an independent test saw 2 of 3 tasks succeed within 48 hours. Scope is narrow: telecom, cable and subscriptions. Landlords, security deposits, utility hardship programs and government agencies are mostly unserved.
ios_hooks: Share sheet extension (forward a bill PDF or screenshot)
VisionKit / Foundation Models OCRTool (read the bill)
nearest_existing: Pine AI (https://www.19pine.ai/): calls, emails and web tasks to negotiate bills, cancel and file refunds
Rocket Money Rowan (https://www.pymnts.com/news/artificial-intelligence/2026/this-ai-agent-ends-subscriptions-without-a-phone-call/): cancels subscriptions by text instruction
Meta Muse (https://the-decoder.com/muse-can-shop-write-emails-and-negotiate-prices-for-users-all-through-whatsapp/): negotiates prices and bills, including through WhatsApp
Cleo Autopilot (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/cleo-launches-autopilot-automating-your-money-moves-302679691.html): bill negotiation planned for 2026
unsaid_assumption: That retention desks keep offering discounts once most of their callers are agents that never give up.
surprise: Retention desks were designed around humans who hang up after 40 minutes on hold; an agent that doesn't mind waiting breaks that model, which is why this vertical works earlier than most.

title: Health-record reading assistants
tagline: Assistants that read Apple Health and medical records to explain labs and prep you for appointments.
moment: Your yearly bloodwork posts to the patient portal at 9pm. You ask the assistant what changed; it pulls last year's labs and your sleep and activity trends, and drafts three questions for Thursday's appointment.
what_it_does: Reads HealthKit data (sleep, activity, medications through the Medications API) with your permission
Pulls connected medical records and compares lab results over time
Summarizes what changed since your last appointment and relates sleep and activity to outcomes
Drafts questions for the visit and keeps a medication list
Rarely acts outside the chat: booking, refills and appeals are still up to you
why_now: ChatGPT Health began broad US rollout on July 23, 2026; Claude added Apple Health analysis in beta in Jan 2026; HealthKit gained a Medications API at WWDC25. Apple shelved its own Mulberry AI coach, which left the field open.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: OpenAI (ChatGPT Health, US-only) and Anthropic (Claude Health beta, US Pro and Max) lead; Apple's redesigned Health app with a Readiness score is in the iOS 27.2 beta but its guidance is not live. HealthKit rules allow sharing only with services that provide health or fitness services to the user and ban ads and data mining, which limits who can build this. Today these are readers and explainers; few take actions.
ios_hooks: Foundation Models / Private Cloud Compute (private processing)
nearest_existing: ChatGPT Health (https://www.macrumors.com/2026/07/23/chatgpt-apple-health-integration/): Apple Health plus medical records; US rollout July 2026
Claude Apple Health integration (https://www.macrumors.com/2026/01/22/claude-ai-adds-apple-health-connectivity/): beta for US Pro and Max users
Apple Health AI coach, shelved (https://livity-app.com/en/blog/apple-health-ai-coach-shelved)
unsaid_assumption: That people trust a chatbot company with their records more than their hospital's own portal.
surprise: Apple holds the richest health data on the phone yet shelved its own coach, so the first big HealthKit agents came from chatbot companies, and they read far more than they do.

title: Wearable-driven training coaches
tagline: Coaches that rewrite today's workout from last night's sleep, HRV and strain, and nudge you on the wrist.
moment: You slept five hours and your HRV dropped. At 6:30am your coach swaps the interval run for an easy 30 minutes, moves the hard session to Thursday, and tells you why in two lines.
what_it_does: Reads sleep, heart rate, HRV and readiness from its own wearable or Apple Health
Builds a training plan and adjusts daily targets
Sends daily outlooks and timely nudges
Answers questions in chat with memory of your past patterns (Oura's Memories)
Asks before big plan changes; does not book, buy or message anyone
why_now: Google's Gemini health coach reached iOS in Feb 2026 and the Fitbit app became Google Health in May 2026; Oura Advisor rolled out globally in 2025; WHOOP Coach focuses on training performance. HealthKit added workout zones at WWDC26 and watchOS 27 gained Foundation Models and PCC.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Hardware companies own it: Google/Fitbit, Oura and WHOOP. Their coaches adapt plans and talk; the agent part stops at the plan. Apple, which has the Watch data, shelved its own coach in Feb 2026. A hardware-neutral coach on HealthKit is possible but must follow HealthKit's third-party sharing rules.
ios_hooks: WorkoutKit (send planned workouts to Apple Watch)
Foundation Models and PCC on watchOS 27
nearest_existing: Google Health / Fitbit Gemini coach (https://www.macrumors.com/2026/02/10/google-fitbit-ai-health-coach-ios/): adaptive training plans on iOS since Feb 2026
Oura Advisor (https://www.androidcentral.com/wearables/oura-ring/oura-rolls-out-its-ai-powered-personal-trainer): sleep- and readiness-focused coach with memories
WHOOP Coach (https://wwd.com/beauty-industry-news/wellness/wearable-wellness-devices-oura-whoop-artificial-intelligence-coaching-1236562338/): recovery- and strain-based training coach
unsaid_assumption: That a readiness score reflects how you actually feel well enough to justify changing your plan.
surprise: WHOOP says users asked for 'someone to tell me what to do': the product people pay for is permission to skip the hard workout, not more data.

title: Meeting and memory capture
tagline: Your phone, Watch or a pendant records the conversation; the agent writes notes, to-dos and follow-ups.
moment: You walk out of a hallway meeting with a supplier. You tapped Granola on your Watch when it started, and by the elevator the notes sit under the calendar event with three action items and a drafted follow-up email.
what_it_does: Captures audio from iPhone, Apple Watch or a clip-on recorder (Plaud, Bee)
Transcribes and separates speakers, on device or in the cloud
Links notes to the calendar event and pulls out decisions and to-dos
Drafts follow-up emails and pushes tasks to your tools for you to approve
Builds a searchable memory of past conversations (Bee)
why_now: Granola shipped an Apple Watch app in July 2026; Plaud NotePin S launched in Jan 2026 and Plaud reports 2.5M+ users; Amazon bought Bee and made it free; Otter launched a meeting agent. iOS 26's BGContinuedProcessingTask and on-device speech models such as WhisperKit make long recordings practical.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Crowded: Granola, Otter, Plaud and Amazon's Bee. The memory-pendant side is being absorbed by big platforms: Meta bought Limitless in Dec 2025 and stopped selling it. Most products stop at notes and suggested to-dos; few file follow-ups on their own. Recording laws and App Review guideline 2.5.14 require consent and a visible recording indicator.
ios_hooks: App Intents (Action button to start capture)
nearest_existing: Granola (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/granola-ai-meeting-notes/id6739429409): bot-free meeting notes; Apple Watch capture since July 2026
Plaud NotePin S (https://www.plaud.ai/blogs/news/plaud-unveils-notepins-and-desktop): wearable recorder with iPhone app
Amazon Bee (https://www.layer3labs.io/gear/reviews/bee-ai-pendant): all-day recorder that extracts to-dos and builds memory
Otter Meeting Agent (https://otter.ai/blog/otter-meeting-agent-your-new-collaborative-teammate)
Limitless, discontinued after Meta's purchase (https://legendmemory.ai/blogs/the-archive/limitless-pendant-discontinued-the-best-alternatives-in-2026)
unsaid_assumption: That everyone else in the room is fine with being recorded.
surprise: Independent memory pendants keep getting bought and absorbed (Bee by Amazon, Limitless by Meta), which suggests the lasting value is the memory, not the gadget.

title: Family logistics agents
tagline: A household agent that turns school emails and texts into shared schedules, chores and grocery orders.
moment: The school sends a PDF about picture day, a field-trip form and a bake sale. You forward it to the family agent. It puts the dates on both parents' calendars, assigns the form to your partner and adds eggs to the grocery order.
what_it_does: Takes in forwarded emails, texts and photos of flyers
Pulls out dates, deadlines and requests, and adds them to a shared calendar
Assigns tasks between parents and sends reminders
Plans meals and places grocery orders after approval (Ohai uses Instacart)
Asks when a detail is unclear instead of guessing
why_now: Menlo Ventures named family logistics as a weekly chore people 'still haven't handed off to AI'; Ohai's 'O' charges $9.99/month; share extensions, EventKit and on-device extraction with Foundation Models make capture cheap.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Struggling. Milo, an SMS family assistant backed by OpenAI and YC, shut down in Jan 2026; its founder said AI was 'too early to be reliable' because small extraction errors made family scheduling more work, not less. Ohai (founded by Care.com's Sheila Lirio Marcelo) is live but mostly handles lists, SMS and groceries. Reliable extraction from school emails and co-parent coordination are still open.
ios_hooks: Messages for Business or SMS number
nearest_existing: Ohai 'O' (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ohai-ai-household-assistant/id6477802468): household manager via app and SMS; lists, tasks, meals, Instacart
Milo, shut down Jan 2026 (https://getsense.ai/blog/posts/milo-shutting-down-alternative-2026)
Poke (https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/04/apple-approves-poke-as-the-first-ai-agent-on-its-messages-for-business-platform/): general iMessage agent with calendar and email access
unsaid_assumption: That one wrong date costs less trust than the agent saves in time. Milo found the opposite.
surprise: Family logistics failed on error tolerance, not capability: one missed pickup wipes out months of saved minutes, so this category needs checking-and-confirming design more than a smarter model.

title: Messaging-native personal agents
tagline: A personal agent you text in iMessage or WhatsApp; it watches your accounts and texts you first.
moment: At 6:10am a text arrives from your agent: 'Your 9am moved to 9:30 and check-in for your flight is open. Check you in and tell Sam you'll be late?' You reply 'yes both' and put the phone down.
what_it_does: Connects to Gmail, Calendar, Outlook, Notion, Slack and GitHub with OAuth
Watches for things that need action and messages you first
Takes plain-text instructions and runs the steps on a server
Asks yes or no in the thread before acting, then replies with what it did
Routes each task to the model that fits it
why_now: Apple approved Poke as the first AI agent on Messages for Business in June 2026; Muse runs inside WhatsApp; a16z's 6th Top 100 notes that on mobile, people reach agents mostly through text messaging rather than dedicated apps.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Poke (The Interaction Company, about 100M messages relayed), Meta Muse in WhatsApp, Howie over iMessage, and OpenClaw across 29 chat channels. Third parties cannot read your iMessages on iOS, so the agent has to be the other side of the conversation, through Messages for Business or its own number. Growing; the main risk is prompt injection arriving through the mail and calendars it watches.
nearest_existing: Poke (https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/04/apple-approves-poke-as-the-first-ai-agent-on-its-messages-for-business-platform/): proactive agent inside iMessage

unsaid_assumption: That Apple keeps Messages for Business open to general-purpose agents, not just airlines and banks.
surprise: The agent interface that won is the thread you already check hundreds of times a day, and the door was Apple's business-chat channel, built for airlines and banks.

title: Self-hosted agents, iPhone as node

Shows approval prompts for each requested action
Runs the gateway's automations across 29 chat channels
Works mostly while the app is open; in the background only location events and presence continue
why_now: OpenClaw went viral in Jan 2026 (about 390k GitHub stars by September) and shipped iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch node apps in late June 2026; Hermes Agent from Nous Research (Feb 2026) grew quickly as a self-hosted alternative.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: The OpenClaw Foundation and the Hermes Agent community. Coverage credits the self-hosted, no-data-collection design for getting through App Review. Walls: iOS suspends sockets and blocks camera and screen commands in the background, setup needs Terminal skills, and a 2026 study found that poisoning OpenClaw's state raised attack success from 24.6% to 64-74%.
nearest_existing: OpenClaw iOS node app (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw): self-hosted gateway; phone is a node with approvals
OpenClaw mobile nodes coverage (https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/06/29/openclaw-releases-ios-and-android-companion-node-apps-that-connect-a-phone-to-a-self-hosted-ai-agent-gateway/)
Hermes Agent (https://www.truefoundry.com/blog/openclaw-vs-hermes): self-hosted, self-improving agent used from phone chat apps
unsaid_assumption: That people who self-host an agent also secure it, now that a phone node makes it more powerful.
surprise: The general agent that got through App Review is the one that collects no data at all: the phone is a peripheral and the agent lives on your own machine.

title: On-phone app builders
tagline: Describe an app on your iPhone; an agent writes it, builds it on cloud Macs and ships it to TestFlight.
moment: On the train you describe a tip-splitting app for your climbing group. The agent writes SwiftUI, builds it on a cloud Mac, and 20 minutes later a TestFlight invite arrives. You try it and say 'make the buttons bigger.'
what_it_does: Turns a text or voice prompt into a plan and code (SwiftUI, or React Native and Expo)
Compiles on cloud Macs (Rork Max) or generates and previews on the phone (Bitrig)
Iterates on your feedback and syncs to GitHub
Pushes builds to TestFlight or prepares App Store submission, with you approving the submit

why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Bitrig, Rork, Vibecode and Replit; Anything was pulled on March 30, 2026. Apple enforced Guideline 2.5.2 from Dec 2025 through March 2026, blocking updates for Replit and Vibecode. Reported fixes: open generated apps in an external browser instead of an in-app web view, and, for Vibecode, stop generating software for Apple devices. The category survives by moving execution off the phone.
nearest_existing: Bitrig (https://9to5mac.com/2026/03/06/ai-powered-coding-platform-bitrig-gets-a-mac-app-for-building-iphone-apps/): prompt-to-SwiftUI on iPhone, pushes to TestFlight

unsaid_assumption: That Apple keeps tolerating builders as long as the generated code runs anywhere except inside the reviewed app.
surprise: Apple's objection was never AI writing code; it was code running inside the reviewed app, so the builders survived by turning the iPhone into a remote for cloud Macs.

title: CarPlay voice agents
tagline: Talk to an AI assistant through CarPlay; it answers, drafts and plans, then hands follow-ups to your phone.
moment: You are 40 minutes from home and remember the dentist form due tomorrow. You tap the assistant on the car screen, ask it to draft the email to the office, and it is waiting in the app when you park.

Hands follow-ups to the phone app or connected services

why_nobody_yet_or_wall: General chatbots got there first. Vertical in-car agents (a trip concierge, an EV charging planner, a field-service agent) are rare. Limits: voice only, no wake word, no control of car or phone functions, and Live Activities on the CarPlay Dashboard are the only glanceable status surface.
ios_hooks: Live Activities on the CarPlay Dashboard
nearest_existing: ChatGPT Voice in CarPlay (https://www.engadget.com/ai/openai-brings-chatgpts-voice-mode-to-carplay-191422297.html)
Apple opening CarPlay to chatbots (https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/06/apple-is-working-to-make-carplay-compatible-with-ai-chatbots-like-chatgpt)
Perplexity, Grok and Meta AI in CarPlay; Voice Control template for all categories (https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2026/212/)

title: AI conversation tutors
tagline: Speak with an AI character that adapts mid-conversation; mostly talk, rarely planning your practice week.
moment: Before your Lisbon trip you do a ten-minute video call with Lily. She notices you avoid the past tense, steers the chat to your weekend, and corrects you gently.
what_it_does: Runs real-time voice or video conversations in the target language
Adjusts difficulty and topic within the session
Gives feedback on grammar and pronunciation
Roleplays scenarios such as ordering food or hotel check-in

why_now: Duolingo moved Video Call from Max to Super in Feb 2026, reaching about 10x more learners, and says it more than doubled words spoken per user; speaking led its May 2026 shareholder letter. Speak and Praktika compete to replace human tutors.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Duolingo, Speak and Praktika. Going well commercially, but these are conversational, not agentic: they adapt inside a conversation and barely plan or act outside it. An agentic tutor that plans the learner's week and sets up real-world practice with people is still unbuilt.
nearest_existing: Duolingo Video Call (https://blog.duolingo.com/video-call/): real-time AI conversation with Lily
Speak (https://www.forbes.com/sites/rashishrivastava/2025/11/12/this-startup-is-racing-duolingo-to-replace-human-language-tutors-with-ai/): structured AI speaking curriculum

unsaid_assumption: That fluency comes from more minutes of AI conversation rather than from being pushed into real conversations with people.
surprise: The biggest AI-tutor win came from pricing, not intelligence: moving Video Call into a cheaper tier reached about 10x more learners, while the tutor itself stayed a conversation, not an agent.

title: Scam-call guardian agents
tagline: An AI answers unknown callers, flags scam scripts and cloned voices, and alerts family before money moves.
moment: Your mother gets a call from 'her grandson' who needs bail money. The guardian app picks up the urgency and the payment demand, warns her on screen, and texts you that a suspected voice-clone call is under way.
what_it_does: Answers unknown calls and asks for name and purpose (Apple Call Screening, Hiya)
Scores scam signals: urgent payment demands, fake government threats, AI-generated voices
Labels or blocks numbers through Call Directory extensions or carrier call forwarding to a cloud screener
Alerts a trusted family member and suggests a verification step (elder-focused apps)
Asks the user before connecting a suspicious caller
why_now: iOS 26 shipped Call Screening; Hiya launched an AI call assistant that flags live and deepfake scams; voice-cloned 'grandchild' scams spread; Scammer Guardian says it launched on iPhone in early 2026.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Apple (Call Screening), Hiya, Truecaller and RoboKiller, plus elder-focused apps (Scammer Guardian, SeniorShield, ZoraSafe, CareCircle Voice). On iOS a third party cannot hear live cellular audio, so it relies on forwarding calls to a cloud line, Call Directory blocking or its own VoIP. Research (PreScam) shows LLMs track how a scam escalates only moderately well.
ios_hooks: Carrier call forwarding to a cloud screener
nearest_existing: Apple Call Screening in iOS 26 (https://www.fastcompany.com/91349248/ios-26s-best-new-feature-iphone-better-phone-hold-contacts-unkown-number-hold-assist-call-screening)
Hiya AI Call Assistant (https://www.hiya.com/newsroom/press-releases/hiya-launches-first-ai-call-assistant-that-stops-live-and-deepfake-scams-in-real-time): screens calls and flags deepfake voices
SeniorShield.ai (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/seniorshield-ai-scam-blocker/id6738144273)
Scammer Guardian (https://www.scammerguardian.com/about/): screens scam calls before they reach seniors
ZoraSafe (https://www.zorasafe.com/for-seniors): phishing and QR checks with family alerts
unsaid_assumption: That older adults keep call forwarding and permissions turned on even after the app blocks a real doctor's office once.
surprise: Apple's free built-in screener now sets the floor, so third parties are moving to what Apple does not do: alerting family and spotting cloned voices mid-call.

title: Blind-assist scene agents
tagline: Point the camera and an AI describes the scene, reads the text, and increasingly guides a task step by step.

what_it_does: Describes photos and live scenes, and reads documents and labels
Answers follow-up questions about the image
Hands off to a human volunteer or to a company's support team when AI is not enough
On the business side (Service AI), guides users through a company's own support flow
Rarely acts beyond describing: forms, purchases and portals stay manual
why_now: Be My AI reached iOS users in 36 languages; Be My Eyes sells Service AI to companies such as Microsoft's Disability Answer Desk; iOS 27 adds image input to Foundation Models and a Visual Intelligence camera mode, so apps can add on-device description.
why_nobody_yet_or_wall: Be My Eyes, Microsoft Seeing AI, Envision, Aira and Lazarillo. Mature for description, thin on action. nearest_existing: Be My Eyes / Be My AI (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/be-my-eyes/id905177575): AI image description plus human volunteers
Be My Eyes Service AI (https://www.bemyeyes.com/business/bme-service-ai/): accessible AI support agent sold to companies

unsaid_assumption: That describing the world is still the bottleneck, when more and more it is the inaccessible website after the description.
surprise: The most agentic product here is sold to companies, not to blind users: Service AI fixes a company's own support flow, while the consumer app still stops at describing.

title: Voice home-and-errands agents

title: ADHD task-breakdown planners

title: Medical-bill dispute tools

The $195k Claude case (https://nationaltoday.com/us/ny/dobbs-ferry/news/2026/02/13/ai-helps-patient-negotiate-163-000-off-hospital-bill/)
unsaid_assumption: That hospitals respond to well-cited letters, not only to persistence on the phone.

title: Pocket supervision of work agents

title: Offline on-device LLM apps

what_it_does: Downloads and runs open-weight models with llama.cpp or MLX on the device

A few run tool-calling loops (web search, calculator, device info) or expose Siri and Shortcuts actions (Private LLM)

Rarely act on Calendar, Reminders, Health or Files
